strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction pipeline
strategies.desc: First reduce within node groups (intra-node all-reduce), then across node representatives (inter-node all-reduce), finally broadcast back. Uses 3 dispatches with smaller payloads in the cross-node phase; exploits potential bandwidth asymmetry between intra/inter-node links at world_size=224.

strategies.name: Block-wise selective reduce-scatter then all-gather
strategies.desc: Partition the 12 blocks across ranks using reduce-scatter (each rank owns subset of blocks), compute local scaling, then all-gather to reconstruct full result. Two dispatches (RS+AG) with payload size 12*256; exploits the block structure to parallelize the scaling computation across ranks.

strategies.name: Fused mask-and-reduce with iteration pipelining
strategies.desc: Pre-allocate all intermediate buffers, then pipeline the 7 mask-reduce-scale iterations by overlapping the local masking operations with the previous all-reduce tail. Still 7 all-reduce dispatches but hides local compute latency; maintains the reference algorithm's correctness guarantee through iterative refinement.

strategies.name: Window-group collective with point-to-point exchange
strategies.desc:
Group ranks by their window index, perform group-local all-reduce (using sub-communicators or emulated via send/recv), then cross-group exchange of disjoint blocks. Reduces effective world-size per collective from 224 to ~224/12; uses multiple dispatches but each operates on 1/4 of ranks, potentially better bisection bandwidth utilization.
